@@ -20,8 +20,33 @@ permissions:

 jobs:
+  test-fast:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout current repo
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Setup Bun
+        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with:
+          bun-version: 1.3.11
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Lint and typecheck
+        run: bun run lint && bun run check
+
+      - name: Build
+        run: bun run build
+
+      - name: Run deterministic test lane
+        run: bun test tests --timeout 20000
+
   tarball:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    needs:
+      - test-fast
     outputs:
       release_version: ${{ steps.release-version.outputs.version }}
       npm_tarball_name: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.npm_tarball_name }}
